title: John Steele, Adventurer
paragraphs: An adventure anthology built around the far-traveled John Steele, whose work and wanderings carry him through jungles, deserts, ports, mysteries, and dangerous situations around the world.
Weekly Mutual adventure/thriller built around globe-trotting John Steele.
The run breaks into several distinct periods: Mutual network run (April 26, 1949 to July 16, 1956) on [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Don Douglas (performer), Doc Whipple (performer), Robert Monroe (producer), Elliott Drake (director and writer), Ross Martin (performer), Ted Mallie (announcer), and Sylvan Levin (conductor).
Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]].

The stories often return to dangerous adventure and pursuit, global travel and remote locations, ships, sea travel and maritime danger, expedition, wilderness and exploration, crime, captivity and violence, and sports and competition.
The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Long-running Mutual adventure programming, Postwar global-adventure radio, AFRTS rebroadcast preservation, and Atmospheric adventure scoring.

If you are following the same actors and creative circles, related programs worth opening next include [[show|x-minus-one|X Minus One]], [[show|the-chase|The Chase]], [[show|theater-five|Theater Five]], [[show|yours-truly-johnny-dollar|Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar]], and [[show|dimension-x|Dimension X]].
